blocks.x: I made a lot of records in Europe, ; you know. Yep, I recorded for Polydor in France and I recorded for...I recorded in London; I recorded for Black and Blue; I recorded for...in Canada for Sackville...

Yeah, Pathé Phillip...and I made...I made a lot of records. And I think that helped me to...to become known, although I didn't get much money. What I'd try to do is when I'd make a record I'd get all I'm going to get the first date. 'Cause the rest is a supposition.
You worked all over Europe, too...
Yeah, well I been as far as Zagreb in, you know, in Yugoslavia. I've been to Denmark. I've been to France. I've been to England, Switzerland, Monaco, Spain, Tunisia, Algiers, Morocco and...
